title: Pentek 150235 20" Big Blue Filter Housing (1-1/2" NPT, Pressure Release)

comparisons.notes: Pentek 150235 20in Big Blue housing, 1-1/2in ports, pressure release; listed in stock
Pentek 150235 Big Blue 1-1/2in in/out, 20in, with pressure release

writeup: Pentek's 150235 is the 20-inch Big Blue whole-house filter housing with 1-1/2 inch NPT ports and a pressure-release button, built for high-flow and heavy-sediment setups and taking standard 4.5 x 20 inch cartridges. FilterPure sells it for $63.82 and ServaPure for $78.06.
